cadence: Per slice: parallel worktree build, then an independent RED-PEN agent, then (for a defensive domain) the adversarial-sweep companion attacking from disjoint lenses — NON-NEGOTIABLE before a sequential merge.
Per wave: report at the wave boundary; lessons are baked forward into the next wave.
Isolation: parallel mutation lenses run in a committed worktree (isolation:'worktree') so they cannot race into a false 'backdoor' BLOCK.
adversarial_review.evidence_of_effect: On the email-auth stream the adversarial sweep caught 3 CRITICAL/LOW defects PAST a RED-PEN PASS — a single reviewer cannot self-attest near-zero-FP.
adversarial_review.name: Adversarial review (RED-PEN + adversarial-sweep)
adversarial_review.purpose: Make the near-zero-false-positive bar an AUDITABLE control, not tribal knowledge: no defensive-oracle domain or FACT-class merges without an independent adversarial re-attack that refutes each objection with a real repro and reports only what survives.

sign_off._note: A sign-off slot per audited release. A human reviewer fills one entry; the slots are intentionally EMPTY until signed — an unsigned review is recorded as pending, never fabricated.

entry_schema.findings_ref: path or issue link to the recorded findings
entry_schema.release: git tag or commit the review covered

fact_class_assurance.reproduction_boundary: irreducible-by-dependency: requires the `packaging` library to parse/compare version ranges

irreducible_boundaries.boundary: An external, accredited assessment body is required for an actual Common-Criteria / FedRAMP accreditation. This mapping is the audit-ready INPUT to that process, not the accreditation itself.

Origin/integrity is anchored to out-of-band-pinned Ed25519 trust roots, not a hardware root of trust (TEE). Hardware-backed attestation is not available here and fails closed when no hardware root is present; see LIMIT-attest-tee-hardware.
Re-execution proves a verdict is the correct FUNCTION of the retained evidence; it does not prove the evidence was live. A live re-run inside VIGIL is the producer-supplied honesty bound for that.

NOT an external accreditation; see irreducible_boundaries. Regenerate with docs/assurance/gen_assurance_mapping.py; drift is caught by docs/tests/test_assurance_mapping.py.

security_objectives.cc_family: FDP_ACC / FIA_UAU (access control, authentication of actors)
security_objectives.label: Authorization & scope control
security_objectives.objective: Every host-acting operation is bounded by a signed authority (charter/scope/capability) and a fail-closed gate; an unauthorised or out-of-scope action is refused, not performed.

security_objectives.cc_family: FCO_NRO / FPT_TDC (non-repudiation of origin, inter-TSF data consistency)
security_objectives.label: Evidence integrity & non-repudiation
security_objectives.objective: Every recorded action and finding is tamper-evident and attributable: a hash-chained, signed spine and offline-re-verifiable certificates bind origin and integrity.

security_objectives.cc_family: assurance objective (truth of a reported result)
security_objectives.label: Finding soundness (oracle sole authority)
security_objectives.objective: A FACT is minted only by a deterministic oracle re-executing over retained evidence; an AI judgement, a tool's bytes, or an unproven lead can never be laundered into a FACT.

security_objectives.label: Isolation & containment
security_objectives.objective: The offense and sovereign planes run as two isolated processes; sandboxed execution and the egress floor contain target traffic and third-party applications from the control plane.

security_objectives.fedramp_family: SR / SA — Supply Chain Risk / System & Services Acquisition
security_objectives.label: Supply-chain integrity
security_objectives.objective: What the system is built from is what was chosen: images are digest-pinned, actions are SHA-pinned, locks are hash-verified, and the shipped verifiers are provenance-pinned.

security_objectives.label: Secure configuration & fail-closed posture
security_objectives.objective: Security-relevant configuration is validated fail-closed at startup; a production posture forces the stricter controls on and refuses to start when they are absent.

security_objectives.label: Cryptography & key management
security_objectives.objective: Signing keys are handled fail-closed (hardware backend, m-of-n quorum, escrow at threshold, crypto-shred erasure); keys are passed in, never provisioned by the tool (FATAL-2).

security_objectives.fedramp_family: CP / SI — Contingency Planning / System & Information Integrity
security_objectives.label: Resilience, recovery & observability
security_objectives.objective: Backup, restore, upgrade/rollback and crash-resume are drilled against numeric RPO/RTO; health, readiness and metrics are exposed, and a degraded dependency is made visible.

security_objectives.cc_family: AGD / ALC_FLR (guidance documents, flaw remediation) + claim discipline
security_objectives.label: Assurance governance & documentation honesty
security_objectives.objective: Every product claim resolves to an enforcing symbol and a proving test in a required CI job; limitations are code-grounded and never worded as completeness (claim discipline).
